answered: The prior review's ten findings are answered: the two _profile_coefficients/_mesh_record duplicates now live once in records.py and are imported by both runners; submit_recorded.sh is deleted and submit.sh takes --runner/--tree/--revision; the self-comparing band assertions are removed; the panel check reads the published SVG rather than an archived run path; submit.sh now verifies the runner is in the tree and marks a dirty revision.

findings.text: panels.py:202 still writes a <stem>-preview.png beside every SVG it saves, so the 'one SVG per figure' rule the commit says it honours is enforced only by where the redraw was pointed: a runner run with STORED_STATE_REFUSALS_FIGURES at the committed figures directory leaves an untracked preview that then fails tests/test_stored_state_refusals.py:151.

tests/test_stored_state_refusals.py:114 asserts only that the runner's source contains the import line and :116 that four helper names appear as substrings, which stays true for a runner that imports the comparison's helpers and then restates the fixtures, so it does not enforce what its docstring claims.

tests/test_stored_state_refusals.py:157 re-implements the coloured-path count that scripts/prototypes/stored_state_refusals/panels.py:417 already owns as drawn_series, so the two definitions of 'a series drew ink' can diverge and the published-figure check would not follow the drawing code.

docs/evidence/fragments/forward-solve-near-stored-states/stored-state-refusals-on-the-recorded-mesh.html:144 states that each receipt names source_revision 6816484212613ba4657e3083620bb32b0bd75277, but the per-arm receipts carry no source_revision key at all; only measurement.json in ~/.cache/nova-stored-state-refusals/recorded-cases does, so a reader checking the receipt the sentence names finds nothing.

manifest.md:10 records landing as the bare sha 16399ead2b8652a38a97470b77f5594e2f94f4ae rather than a landing record, so the plan section promotion lands carries no statement of what changed or of the measure's figure.

justifications.durability: tests/test_stored_state_refusals.py:64 and :86 now compare the receipts to constants the runner does not write, so a receipt that drifts reddens them, but the receipts are static files under ~/.cache so no solver regression is caught without a manual GPU re-run.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_stored_state_refusals.py:64 and :86 assert the tightened TCV band and ITER no-axis refusal against constants the test writes, and the committed SVGs were verified byte-identical to the redraw jobs, but the baseline arm exited 4 with no test file present so the comparison proves nothing about added failures.
justifications.fit: The added code follows the sibling prototype's conventions and the figure rules at scripts/prototypes/stored_state_refusals/panels.py:200, declaring the 31.1 x 16 cm canvas the repository's imas-ink style specifies.
justifications.goal_fidelity: scripts/prototypes/stored_state_refusals/run_recorded_cases.py:292 reproduces both recorded refusals only from the tightened continuation arm, so the stored-flux default arm the node goal names as the standing case does not itself assert the recorded values.
justifications.reuse: The profile-coefficient, mesh-record and submission duplications are repaired into scripts/prototypes/stored_state_refusals/records.py:22 and submit.sh:20, leaving the arm loop still written twice at run_cases.py:145 and run_recorded_cases.py:196.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in 6816484212613ba4657e3083620bb32b0bd75277..16399ead2b8652a38a97470b77f5594e2f94f4ae lies inside the four declared write paths and nothing outside them is touched.
